description: Fender material of every landing structure segment in World/Generated/LowerEastRiver/contacts.json, as the core's ContactSurface: values per metre of contact length (docs/conventions.md, contact geometry). No landing or structure has been surveyed, so every value is an estimate. A segment uses its landing's own entry under 'landings' (keyed by GTFS stop_id) when it is part of that landing's barges, else the entry for its contacts.json version 2 kind under 'kinds', else 'default'.

stiffness.source: Estimated elastomeric barge fender, 1.0e6 N/m per metre of contact length: the landing face the core's contact report uses (core/FerrySim.Core/Dynamics/README.md, Contact; ContactReportTests). Not a landing survey.

damping.source: Estimated elastomeric barge fender, 5e4 N·s/m per metre of contact length, as in the core's contact report. Not a landing survey.

friction.source: Estimated Coulomb friction of hull fendering on a rubber barge fender, 0.3, as in the core's contact report. Not a landing survey.

maxCompression.source: Estimated travel of an elastomeric barge fender before it bottoms out, 0.25 m, as in the core's contact report. Not a landing survey.

default.note: One estimate for every landing until crew or a survey give fender type, size and condition per landing (docs/reference-capture-kit.md).

damping.source: Estimated damping of a pile pier with timber fender piles, 7.1e4 N·s/m per metre of contact length: the barge fender's 5e4 scaled by the square root of the stiffness ratio, so the damping ratio stays the same. Not a landing survey.

maxCompression.source: Estimated travel of a pile pier with timber fender piles before it bottoms out, 0.15 m. Not a landing survey.

pier.note: Stiffer and shorter travel than a barge fender: timber fender piles bend less than an elastomeric fender. An estimate until crew or a survey give the fender system per pier.

bulkhead.note: Nearly rigid: the hull's own fendering takes most of the compression. An estimate until crew or a survey give the wall and any fender system.
